script_text: Aries, your Fire element gets a cosmic test from Mars, your ruler, this week. Early week, the Sun enters Sagittarius and lights your 9th House. Saturn in your 1st House squares Uranus in your 3rd, making plans and messages feel unstable. Wednesday is your power day because the Sun sextiles Pluto in your 11th House, helping you network for money and contracts. Midweek, Venus in Libra enters your 7th House and sextiles Mars in Leo, heating romance and collaboration. Thursday is the hardest day because the Moon squares Mars in your 5th House, bringing tension. Late week, Saturn in your 1st House keeps you disciplined, but avoid signing anything until you sleep on it. The weekend requires patience as the Moon moves through Cancer, yet Venus still asks for fairness in partnerships. Your best move: delay decisions and protect your energy. Follow for daily updates.
